uutiset.t: Colleges Rejecting Fossil Fuel Divestment Enjoy a Rich Payoff
uutiset.s: For years, campus and environmental activists concerned about climate change have pressured colleges to divest from fossil fuel companies. But those that hung tight are now glad they did. Bloomberg’s Janet Lorin explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: LME to List Major New Aluminum Brand as Historic Squeeze Deepens
uutiset.s: The London Metal Exchange is preparing to authorize deliveries of aluminum from a major new smelter in Indonesia into its warehousing network, offering potential supply relief as a historic squeeze roils the global market.

uutiset.t: Mercuria Hires Alex Humphries as Global Head of Fuel Oil Trading Ahead of Eni JV
uutiset.s: Mercuria Energy Group Ltd. hired Alex Humphries from BP Plc as head of fuel oil trading, adding to the list of senior appointments ahead of the firm’s trading venture with Eni SpA.

uutiset.t: Sanofi Agrees to Buy US Biotech Insmed for $41 Billion
uutiset.s: Sanofi agreed to buy US biotech Insmed for $41 billion in the biggest pharma acquisition in three years, expanding the French company’s immunology and rare-disease portfolio as it faces the loss of patent protection on its top-selling drug. uutiset.s: Australia is looking to sign another security deal to limit Chinese access to the Pacific, with the leader of the Solomon Islands in Canberra for talks.

uutiset.t: Xi Delays US Chip Retaliation After Trump Seals Nvidia U-Turn
uutiset.s: China extended the suspension of a ban on exports of several critical minerals to the US, holding back a potential response to Washington’s latest chip curbs hours after President Donald Trump helped restore Jensen Huang to the helm of Nvidia Corp.

uutiset.t: European Auto Sales Increase Again on Surging EV Demand
uutiset.s: European car sales rose for a ninth straight month in October, with a surge in electric-vehicle demand helping sustain a market facing record fuel prices and pressure on household budgets. Bloomberg's Elisabeth Behrmann reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Hong Kong Hedge Fund Tax Breaks Offer Win for Pod Shop Stars
uutiset.s: Hong Kong plans to link part of its sweeping hedge fund tax breaks to the performance of individual portfolios rather than the overall returns of funds, boosting the city’s appeal to profitable managers at pod shops.

uutiset.t: Dangote Clears Key Hurdle Toward Africa’s Biggest Listing
uutiset.s: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE cleared a key hurdle needed for it to start trading on Nigeria’s stock exchange as the nation’s finance watchdog approved how shares in its initial public offering will be distributed among investors.
